name: table-control-over-character
checks: A code the entry's controls name is that control, also when a table file lists it as a character: F005 (name) is nothing, though the second table has a character for it. F007 is only in the table, as a space. And a code may be up to 32 bytes long: F019 here is 18, a control and eight argument words, skipped whole.
